explication: Zalith Launcher 2 is an Android Minecraft: Java Edition launcher. The principal workflow is user interaction with launcher UI, account/game preparation, downloads and JVM startup, followed by game execution and foreground-service supervision. The repository also contains a substantial file manager, controller/input support, configurable control layers, audio, and Terracotta VPN networking. The tree and sampled files establish service and helper relationships; several UI-to-domain connections remain intentionally unasserted because their callers were not sampled.
